$comment: ADG collection orchestrator. Copy this file, edit it, and point one Windows scheduled
task at Invoke-AdgCollection.ps1 on a short interval (every 15 minutes is a reasonable
default). Each job decides for itself whether it is due, so one task drives all six.
No secrets here, ever. The API credential is read from the environment variable the
collector configurations name (default ADG_COLLECTOR_KEY).
The six job kinds and what each may claim:
ad_principals        delta by uSNChanged; never reconciles (reads half the domain)
ad_memberships       delta by uSNChanged; never reconciles (reads half the domain)
smb_inventory        always full; may reconcile (a server has tens of shares)
ntfs_important_roots always incremental (a named subset, on purpose)
ntfs_deep_scan       full walk; affirms unchanged descriptors; may reconcile
full_reconciliation  every collector, everything, reconciling. The repair pass.
Why the reconciliation job exists at all: a delta reads what its source says has
changed, and nothing announces a deletion to a query that filters on change metadata.
A deleted principal simply fails to appear, which is exactly what an unchanged one
does. Running the deltas more often never tells them apart. Only this does.
The trees whose permissions matter most, read often. Narrowed on purpose, so it is
marked incremental and never reconciles: reconciling a subset would mark every
directory outside it as deleted.
jobs.name: ntfs-important-roots

$comment: The whole tree, overnight. It re-reads every descriptor -- writing an ACL moves no
timestamp a walk could test, so there is nothing safe to skip -- but re-sends only
the ones whose digest changed, and affirms the rest. That is what lets it remain a
complete enumeration, and keep the right to reconcile, at a fraction of the payload.
Set digestIndexPath in the NTFS collector configuration to enable the affirmations.
jobs.name: ntfs-deep-scan

$comment: The repair pass. Everything, from every collector, reconciling every scope. This is
the only job that can discover that something is gone, so its interval is the upper
bound on how long ADG can believe in access that no longer exists.
jobs.name: full-reconciliation
